title: Escalation matrix — who to go to
keywords: escalate escalation who to contact manager philip carmen hamyzan faiq william mabeline
body: Level 1 — CS / Fulfilment officer: all first-line issues, within response times.
Level 2 — Philip (Fulfilment, telemedical) or Carmen (CS); Hamyzan for SGH and Tsuklio: agent MIA, outsourcing decisions, disputes, anything unresolved over 1 shift.
Level 3 — Faiq, Operations Manager: platform penalties, claims needing judgement, missed targets, high load, client complaints.
Level 4 — William Ng, COO: contract breaches, service suspension, rate changes, major incidents.
Level 4 (finance) — Mabeline Xie, CFO: claims over the agreed limit, refunds, payout disputes, write-offs.
